faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: Quantik is an AI-powered trading platform for Polymarket. You create a personalized trading agent backed by a swarm of 7 specialized sub-agents that analyze sentiment, liquidity, probability, risk, and more — then execute trades autonomously.
faq.a2: Yes. Quantik is free to use with paper trading (simulated capital). When you're ready to trade with real funds, you connect your own Polymarket wallet.
faq.a3: Paper trading lets you test your agent's strategy with simulated USDC. All trades, positions, and P&L are tracked realistically — but no real money is at risk. It's the default mode for all new agents.
faq.a4: Every trade decision passes through a pipeline of specialized agents: AURA (sentiment), FLUX (liquidity), CLAUSE (contract risk) run in parallel, then ORACLE (probability), EDGE (sizing), LUCIFER (devil's advocate), and finally SIGMA (synthesis) produce the final trade decision.
faq.a5: Quantik supports all prediction markets on Polymarket — politics, sports, crypto, science, entertainment, and more. Your agent's market scanner discovers opportunities automatically.

architecture.agentDescAura: Analyzes market sentiment from news, social media, and financial feeds. Detects echo chambers and contrarian signals.
architecture.agentDescEdge: Calculates expected value, Kelly fraction, and optimal position sizing based on probability estimates and market odds.
architecture.agentDescOracle: Estimates true probability using ensemble ML models, historical patterns, and LLM reasoning. Compares against market-implied odds.
architecture.agentDescLucifer: Devil's advocate agent. Challenges bullish theses, identifies bias flags, and can veto trades that fail stress tests.
architecture.agentDescFlux: Routes liquidity across DEXs (Uniswap, Curve, 1inch). Monitors spread, depth, and whale activity for optimal execution.
architecture.agentDescClause: Evaluates smart contract risks, resolution mechanics, and gas optimization for on-chain trading operations.
architecture.agentDescSigma: Final decision engine. Synthesizes all agent outputs into a BET_YES, BET_NO, or PASS with confidence-weighted sizing.
architecture.agentDescFallback: Specialized sub-agent in the trading pipeline.

aura.title: Sentiment Oracle
aura.description: AURA scans the pulse of social media, news feeds, and community sentiment in real-time. She reads the crowd's emotional state to detect fear, greed, and momentum shifts before they show up in price action.

activityText.idle: Monitoring social feeds passively, waiting for pipeline activation.
activityText.running: Scanning Twitter, Reddit, Discord, and news APIs for sentiment signals.
activityText.done: Sentiment analysis complete — crowd mood and momentum indicators locked in.
activityText.error: Feed aggregation failed — API rate limits or connectivity issues detected.

flux.title: Liquidity Analyst
flux.description: FLUX dives deep into order books, volume flows, and liquidity depth. He maps where the money is moving, detects whale activity, and identifies thin markets where slippage could eat your edge.

activityText.idle: Watching order book depth and volume flow patterns.
activityText.running: Analyzing liquidity pools, tracking volume spikes and whale orders.
activityText.done: Liquidity map complete — volume patterns and depth analysis delivered.
activityText.error: Order book data stream interrupted — exchange API timeout.

clause.title: Contract Auditor
clause.description: CLAUSE is the legal mind of the pipeline. She parses Polymarket resolution criteria, identifies ambiguous clauses, and flags contracts where the outcome could be disputed or misinterpreted.

activityText.idle: Standing by, monitoring contract terms for changes.
activityText.running: Parsing resolution criteria, checking for ambiguities and edge cases.
activityText.done: Contract audit complete — resolution risk and clause analysis ready.
activityText.error: Parse error — contract structure mismatch or undefined terms.

oracle.title: Probability Engine
oracle.description: ORACLE is the mathematical core. He ingests all market data, runs Monte Carlo simulations, and computes calibrated probability estimates. His numbers are the foundation every downstream agent relies on.

activityText.idle: Models idle, awaiting parallel phase completion.
activityText.running: Running Monte Carlo simulations, calibrating probability models.
activityText.done: Probabilities computed — calibrated estimates delivered to EDGE.
activityText.error: Model divergence — numerical instability or data feed corruption.

edge.title: Position Sizer
edge.description: EDGE calculates optimal position sizes using Kelly criterion and custom risk models. He weighs the probability edge against downside risk to determine exactly how much capital to deploy.

activityText.idle: Risk parameters loaded, awaiting Oracle's probability output.
activityText.running: Computing Kelly fraction, running drawdown simulations.
activityText.done: Position sized — risk-reward ratio and optimal stake calculated.
activityText.error: Negative edge detected — no viable position size within risk limits.

lucifer.title: Devil's Advocate
lucifer.description: LUCIFER exists to break your thesis. He stress-tests every assumption, finds the holes in your logic, and plays devil's advocate so you don't walk into a trap. If he can't break it, the thesis is strong.

activityText.idle: Sharpening arguments, waiting for a thesis to tear apart.
activityText.running: Stress-testing thesis from every angle, probing for weaknesses.
activityText.done: Challenge complete — thesis either hardened or flagged with red flags.
activityText.error: Logic failure — too many contradictions to reconcile.

sigma.title: Final Synthesizer
sigma.description: SIGMA is the commander. He weighs every signal from all 6 agents, resolves conflicts, and renders the final GO/NO-GO decision. His word is the last before capital moves.

activityText.idle: Awaiting all agent signals for final synthesis.
activityText.running: Weighing all signals, resolving conflicts, computing final verdict.
activityText.done: Verdict rendered — trade decision synthesized from all 7 agents.
activityText.error: Synthesis failed — conflicting signals could not be reconciled.

agentPipeline.fluxDescABPlenty: This market is easy to buy and sell in — tight pricing with plenty of money available.
agentPipeline.fluxDescABEnough: This market is easy to buy and sell in — tight pricing with enough money available.
agentPipeline.fluxDescC: Trading here costs a bit more — gaps in pricing may eat into your returns.
agentPipeline.fluxDescD: This market is thin — buying or selling could move the price against you significantly.
agentPipeline.oracleTooltipAbove: Our model thinks this is more likely than the market does — a potential buying opportunity.
agentPipeline.oracleTooltipBelow: Our model sees this as less likely than what the market prices — caution advised.
agentPipeline.oracleTooltipNeutral: Our model agrees with the market price — no clear advantage either way right now.
agentPipeline.edgeDescStrong: The price looks off — our math says this bet pays more than it should on average.
agentPipeline.edgeDescModest: There's a small gap in your favor, but the advantage is modest — size carefully.
agentPipeline.edgeDescWeak: The numbers don't favor this bet right now — the market price looks fair or expensive.
agentPipeline.insightFallbackEdge: Our model gives this a {conf}% chance of resolving YES, which is higher than what the market currently prices in — suggesting there may be an opportunity here.
agentPipeline.insightFallbackProb: Our model puts the probability at {conf}% — review the details below before making any decision.
agentPipeline.insightFallbackDefault: Pipeline complete. Check the agent cards above for the full breakdown.
agentPipeline.bankrollDesc: Based on ${amount}k live bankroll • 1/4 Kelly Fraction
agentPipeline.noBankroll: No funded bankroll detected yet. Fund the wallet before sizing live trades.
agentPipeline.auraTooltip: Scans news, social media, and forums to read the crowd's mood on this market. If everyone's excited or worried, Aura catches it so you know what people are feeling before you trade.
agentPipeline.fluxTooltip: Checks if enough money is flowing through this market for you to trade smoothly. Busy markets mean better prices. Flux warns you when a market is too quiet and trading could cost you extra.
agentPipeline.oracleTooltip: Our AI's best guess at what will actually happen. It compares its prediction to the current market price — when they disagree, that gap might mean the market is getting it wrong.
agentPipeline.clauseTooltip: Reads the fine print of market rules. Some markets have tricky settlement conditions. Clause spots hidden technicalities that could make you lose even when you're right about the outcome.
agentPipeline.edgeTooltip: Crunches the numbers to tell you if this bet is actually worth your money. It calculates your potential profit and suggests how much to invest based on your balance.
agentPipeline.luciferTooltip: The devil's advocate. It deliberately tries to poke holes in what the other agents found. If there's a reason this trade could go wrong, Lucifer finds it before your money is at risk.
agentPipeline.alphaSignalTooltip: Shows the bottom line — how much you could make and the ideal bet size based on your wallet balance and the math from all the other agents.
agentPipeline.validatorTooltip: The final safety check before any trade goes through. It runs through a checklist — is the math strong enough, is the market liquid, did the critic approve? Only if everything checks out does it give the green light.

sigma.fundWalletFull: Fund your wallet with USDC to place trades and POL to cover gas fees.
sigma.noUsdc: No USDC balance detected. Fund your wallet before placing trades.
sigma.noPol: Not enough POL for gas fees. Send POL to your wallet to enable trading.
sigma.lowEdge: Lower expected value — proceed with caution.

tutorial.restartDesc: Walk through the key features of Quantik again.
tutorial.restartNotAvailable: Complete your first agent setup to unlock the tutorial.
tutorial.factoryIntroDesc: This is your agent factory. Start here to launch a new Quantik agent or bring an existing OpenClaw runtime into the stack.
tutorial.factoryCreateDesc: This is the primary path for new users. The guided builder sets identity, strategy, risk posture, and wallet before your first deployment.
tutorial.factoryByoDesc: Already running OpenClaw? Import it here, claim the Quantik onboarding session, and continue into the same dashboard and control surface.
tutorial.factoryDeployedDesc: Your agent is live! This is the Factory where you built it. Now let's explore what it can do.
tutorial.identityDesc: Your agent's identity — name, avatar, wallet balance, and live status at a glance.
tutorial.autopilotDesc: When enabled, the 7-agent pipeline evaluates markets and executes trades autonomously.
tutorial.viewTabsDesc: Switch between Dashboard analytics, Architecture view (see how the 7 agents connect), and Agent World.
tutorial.missionControlDesc: Your real-time command center. Portfolio value, P&L, and system health — all in one place.
tutorial.missionRailDesc: Your 7 specialized agents and their live status. Green means online and ready to analyze.
tutorial.orchestratorDesc: Scans Polymarket for opportunities. Hit 'Scan Now' to trigger an immediate market sweep.
tutorial.arenaDesc: Where all agents compete on the global leaderboard. Rankings based on real trading performance.
tutorial.arenaStageDesc: Top 3 agents on the podium. The champion holds center throne. Can your agent dethrone them?
tutorial.arenaPositionDesc: This is you. Make profitable trades, climb the ranks. You're ready to compete.
tutorial.wizardNameDesc: Start by giving your agent a name and picking an avatar. This is how it'll appear across the platform and in the Arena leaderboard.
tutorial.wizardPersonalityDesc: This shapes how your agent evaluates risk vs. reward. Guardian plays safe, Adventurer goes bold, Balanced splits the difference.
tutorial.wizardInstinctDesc: This tells the pipeline HOW your agent finds trades — chasing trends, spotting reversals, hunting value, or going for speed.
tutorial.wizardMoneyDesc: How much capital per trade and how tight the safety net. This is the difference between steady growth and blowout risk.
tutorial.wizardSenseDesc: Pick whether your agent follows fixed rules or reads market mood, and which asset classes it specializes in.
tutorial.wizardNextDesc: Fill in each section, then hit the green button to advance. You can always go back to change things later.
